verification.source: Payroll aggregators; NOT individual state agency confirmation
verification.note: Bucket A only: employee-side SDI/TDI/PFML/PFL. Rates and wage bases here come from payroll aggregators, not each state's agency, and these programs change rate every single year - they are the most volatile numbers in the whole dataset. Confirm against each state agency before relying on them. States with a known employee-side program that is NOT yet modelled are listed under `notModelled` rather than being silently omitted.

notes: Employee share ONLY. Employer-side contributions are not deductions from employee pay.
Charged on GROSS wages, not on taxable income after deductions.
`wageBase: null` means no cap - the rate applies to all wages.
A state absent from `states` and absent from `notModelled` has no employee-side program.

contributions.label: CA SDI
contributions.note: Includes Paid Family Leave. Wage cap was removed from 2024, so this applies to all wages.

contributions.label: NJ FLI
contributions.note: Family Leave Insurance, funded entirely by employee deductions.

contributions.label: NY PFL
contributions.note: Paid Family Leave. NY caps the ANNUAL contribution at a fixed dollar amount tied to the statewide average weekly wage; that cap is not modelled, so this slightly overstates the deduction for very high earners.

notModelled.reason: These jurisdictions operate an employee-side payroll contribution but a reliable 2026 employee rate and wage base was not confirmed. Listed explicitly so the gap is visible rather than looking like 'no program'.
